_comment: Copy this file to ops-alert.config.json (gitignored) on the PROD server and fill it in. Used by backup-db.ps1 and healthcheck.ps1.

smtp._comment: SMTP used ONLY for ops alert emails (backup/health) — independent of the app's mail. Use port 587 (STARTTLS). A Zoho mailbox app-password works (MX is already Zoho). NOT port 465.

backup._comment_rclone: rcloneRemote = 'remoteName:folder' created by 'rclone config'. Leave rcloneRemote empty to keep backups LOCAL ONLY (not recommended). rcloneConfig points the SYSTEM task at the token you created under your user.
